report.io.py: Added logging import + module-level logger. Wrapped load_image() in try/except catching FileNotFoundError, ValueError (cv2 decode failure), and generic Exception. Logs at error level for each case; re-raises ValueError with context for callers.
report.grayscale.py: Added logging + guards for None input, non-ndarray type, unexpected dimensions (not 2 or 3), and empty images. Returns None for None input, returns input unchanged for other failures. Existing conversion wrapped in try/except.
report.baseline_metrics.py: Added logging + module-level _DEFAULTS dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty image, wrong ndim. Whole computation wrapped in try/except returning defaults. Edge case: min_intensity/max_intensity now returned as float for type consistency.
report.skew_analysis.py: Added logging + module-level _DEFAULTS dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty, wrong ndim. Each OpenCV stage (adaptiveThreshold, Canny, HoughLines) individually wrapped. Angle computation from lines also guarded. Returns safe defaults on any failure.
report.illumination.py: Added logging + _empty_meta dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty. GaussianBlur, cv2.divide, CLAHE creation/application, and metrics computation each individually wrapped in try/except. Falls back to original gray + empty meta.
report.binarization.py: Added logging + _empty_meta dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty, wrong ndim. block_size validation: even numbers are bumped to odd, < 3 clamped to 3. adaptiveThreshold and metrics computation individually wrapped. Falls back to normalized + empty meta.
report.border_removal.py: Added logging + _empty_meta dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty, wrong ndim. Already handled no-content case (no rows/cols). Added debug-level logging for expected no-ops. Whole processing wrapped in try/except.
report.fusion.py: Added logging + math import for isfinite checks. Guards for None and non-dict. Missing/None/NaN/Inf keys replaced with 0.0 with warning. All 9 required keys validated individually. Whole score computation wrapped in try/except, returns 0.0 on failure.
report.dpi.py: Added logging. scale() and kernel_sizes() both guard against None or non-positive dpi, warn and fall back to default 300 DPI.
report.structure_prep.py: Added logging + _defaults dict. Guards for None, non-ndarray, empty, wrong ndim. Invalid template_size (None or wrong length) replaced with image dimensions. ORB detection and whole processing wrapped in try/except.

edge_cases_discovered: cv2.imread returns None (not raises) on corrupt/missing files — now caught and wrapped in ValueError with logging
Single-value images (all black/white) cause Otsu/adaptiveThreshold to fail — now caught with fallback
NaN/Inf metrics propagate silently into fusion score — now sanitized to 0.0 per key
Even block_size for adaptiveThreshold causes OpenCV error — now auto-corrected to nearest odd
CLAHE clahe.apply() can fail on unexpected image types — now caught with corrected image fallback
DPI metadata may be missing or invalid (None, 0, negative) — now defaults to 300 DPI with warning
HoughLines returning empty/trivially parseable lines — angle computation now guarded
findContours (though not used directly) replaced by numpy-based content detection — np.where on empty slices handled
